title: Lester Assassinations & Stock Market Investment Strategy ($2.1B Payout)
contentMarkdown:
# Lester Assassination Stock Market Investment Strategy

Maximizing your cash reserves in GTA V Story Mode requires saving Lester Crest's assassination missions until after completing the main campaign heist, "The Big Score". With ~$25M-$30M starting capital per character, strategic investments on LCN and BAWSAQ will yield the hard maximum of $2,147,483,647 for Michael, Franklin, and Trevor.

## Golden Investment Rules
- **Complete The Big Score First**: Only the first mission ("Hotel Assassination") is mandatory to advance the main story. Postpone the remaining four missions until all campaign heist money is wired.
- **Invest with All 3 Characters**: Before accepting each contract from Lester, switch between Franklin, Michael, and Trevor and invest 100% of their cash into the designated company.
- **Advance Market Cycles**: Save your game at safehouse beds (skipping 6 to 8 hours) without overwriting your master save, checking stock prices via the iFruit phone browser.

## Mission Sequence & Target Stocks
1. **Hotel Assassination**: Invest in Betta Pharmaceuticals (BET) on BAWSAQ before the mission. Sell at 80% profit. Wait 48-72 in-game hours and buy Bilkinton (BIL) on LCN when it hits rock bottom ($80-$100/share); sell when it rebounds at ~100% gain.
2. **The Multi Target Assassination**: Invest in Debonaire (DEB) on LCN before starting. Sell once it reaches ~80% profit. Immediately put 100% into Redwood (RWD) on LCN; sleep multiple times until Redwood recovers for a ~300% return.
3. **The Vice Assassination**: Invest in Fruit (FRT) on BAWSAQ before the mission. Sell at ~50% profit. Reinvest in Facade (FAC) on BAWSAQ and sell at ~30% rebound profit.
4. **The Bus Assassination**: Do NOT invest before the job. Complete the mission, then immediately dump all capital into Vapid (VAP) on BAWSAQ after the stock crashes. Sell at ~100% recovery profit.
5. **The Construction Assassination**: Invest in GoldCoast (GCD) on LCN before the mission. Sell at ~80% profit.

title: Hidden Ocean Briefcases & Sunken Caches Farming Guide
contentMarkdown:
# Ocean Hidden Briefcases and Underwater Caches

Scattered along the coastlines and deep trenches of San Andreas are 12 hidden underwater briefcases containing cash bundles ranging from $7,500 to $25,000. These are accessible immediately from the prologue and provide essential early-game cash for weapon upgrades, body armor, and vehicle customization.

## Key Equipment & Preparations
- **Scuba Gear & Dinghy**: Purchase the Sonar Collections Dock in Paleto Cove ($250,000) or acquire a Nagasaki Dinghy from the coast; exiting a Dinghy automatically equips your character with full scuba gear and infinite oxygen.
- **Submersible**: Available at the Sandy Shores airfield airstrip or near Sonar Collections Dock. Provides safe descent into deep trenches without pressure damage.
- **Body Armor**: Ensure full armor before diving near shallow reefs where sharks patrol the Pacific perimeter.

## Top Value Cash Cache Locations
- **Paleto Bay Wreck ($25,000)**: Located northwest of Paleto Bay inside the sunken tail section of a cargo aircraft. Rest on the ocean floor next to an open hatch.
- **Chumash Sunken Cargo Ship ($12,000)**: Found west of Banham Canyon inside the corroded engine compartment of a sunken freighter.
- **Palomino Highlands Wreckage ($20,000)**: Southeast coast of Los Santos, positioned inside the wheelhouse of a destroyed industrial barge.
- **Altruist Camp Ridge ($25,000 x 4)**: Inside the Altruist Cult compound in the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness, 4 briefcases totaling $100,000 spawn on the wooden porch and perimeter rocks after clearing the cult shootout.

title: Gruppe Sechs Armored Truck Hijacking & Quick Escape Tactics
contentMarkdown:
# Gruppe Sechs Armored Security Truck Robberies

Armored security vans operated by Gruppe Sechs spawn dynamically across Los Santos and Blaine County as blue blips on your minimap. Each successful heist awards between $3,000 and $10,000 cash, serving as rapid infusion for early game ammunition and weapon mods.

## Breaching Methods
- **Sticky Bomb Method (Fastest)**: Throw a Sticky Bomb onto the center seam of the rear security doors. Detonate from a safe distance while driving alongside or behind the truck. The doors will blow open, dropping the green money briefcase.
- **Shotgun Point-Blank Blast**: If explosives are unavailable, aim a heavy shotgun (Assault Shotgun or Pump Shotgun) directly at the center door handle from point-blank range and fire 3-5 consecutive rounds.
- **Driver Elimination Intercept**: Shoot the guards as they carry the case from convenience stores or gas stations before they enter the cab to avoid triggering high-speed chases.

## Escaping the 2-Star / 3-Star Wanted Level
- **Subway & Underground Rail Tunnels**: Los Santos features extensive underground metro systems. Head down the tracks near Pillbox Hill or the LS River storm drain where police cruisers cannot follow.
- **Los Santos River Flood Canal**: Drive into the concrete storm channel and cut through the maintenance tunnels beneath Olympic Freeway until stars flash and clear.
- **Pay 'n' Spray Respray**: Pull into any Los Santos Customs garage with a clean line of sight break to instantly erase your heat.

title: Story Mode 100% Completion Master Checklist & Optimal Roadmap
contentMarkdown:
# Story Mode 100% Completion Master Checklist

Achieving 100% completion in Grand Theft Auto V unlocks the "Career Criminal" achievement/trophy, spawns the Mount Chiliad UFO, and awards the special orange tee. The requirement does not require doing every single activity, but rather a curated breakdown across five core disciplines.

## Five Core Completion Categories
1. **Story Missions (50%)**: Complete all 69 main story missions, including Lester's assassinations and the final choice (Option C "The Third Way" is recommended to keep all three protagonists alive).
2. **Strangers & Freaks (10%)**: Complete 20 specific Strangers and Freaks missions. Crucially, only Franklin's missions count towards this total (Tonya, Hao, Beverly, Barry, Mary-Ann, Dom, Omega, and Peter Dreyfuss).
3. **Hobbies & Pastimes (10%)**:
   - Win at Darts, Tennis, and 9 Holes of Golf (even or under par).
   - Win all 3 Triathlons (Vespucci, Alamo Sea, and the 30-minute Coyote Cross Country).
   - Win all 5 Street Races and 6 Off-Road Races.
   - Win all 4 Sea Races.
   - Obtain at least bronze in all Flight School lessons and Ammu-Nation Shooting Range challenges.
   - Complete 5 Stunt Plane trials and all Parachuting jumps.
4. **Random Events (15%)**: Complete any 14 Random World Events (such as ATM robberies, hitchhikers, shoplifting, or bike thieves) across San Andreas.
5. **Miscellaneous (15%)**:
   - Collect all 50 Spaceship Parts and 50 Letter Scraps.
   - Complete 25 Under the Bridge, 8 Knife Flights, and 25 Stunt Jumps.
   - Purchase any 5 income-generating properties.
   - Purchase a vehicle from the web and visit the cinema.
   - Walk and play fetch with Chop the dog.
   - Pick up a prostitute and receive a private dance at the Vanilla Unicorn.

## Optimal Progression Strategy
- Finish the 69 story missions first while leaving Lester's assassinations for maximum stock wealth.
- Use Franklin's special ability (driving slow-motion) to effortlessly sweep Street Races and Stunt Jumps.
- Use a helicopter (Buzzard or Frogger) for rapid collection of Spaceship Parts and Letter Scraps.

title: Franklin's Essential Strangers & Freaks Guide for 100% Checklist
contentMarkdown:
# Franklin's Essential Strangers and Freaks Guide

For the official 100% Career Criminal checklist, only 20 specific Strangers & Freaks missions must be completed, and every single qualifying mission must be done as Franklin Clinton. Michael's and Trevor's side quests provide fun lore and cash, but Franklin's are mandatory.

## The 20 Required Missions
- **Tonya Wiggins (5 Towing Missions)**:
  - *Pulling Favors*, *Pulling Another Favor*, *Pulling Favors Again*, *Still Pulling Favors*, and *Pulling One Last Favor*.
  - Tip: Missions 3 and 4 require calling Tonya via cell phone rather than waiting for map markers.
- **Beverly Felton (4 Paparazzo Missions)**:
  - *Paparazzo*, *Paparazzo - The Sex Tape*, *Paparazzo - The Partnership*, and *Paparazzo - Reality Check*.
- **Hao (1 Street Racing Mission)**:
  - *Shift Work*: Complete the inaugural South Los Santos midnight street race to unlock the remaining races.
- **Barry (2 Grass Roots Missions)**:
  - *Grass Roots - Franklin* and *Grass Roots - The Smoke-In*.
- **Mary-Ann Quinn (1 Exercise Mission)**:
  - *Exercising Demons - Franklin*: Win the foot and bicycle sprint against Mary-Ann at Paleto Bay.
- **Dom Beasley (4 Extreme Sports Missions)**:
  - *Risk Assessment*, *Liquidity Risk*, *Targeted Risk*, and *Uncalculated Risk* (unlocked after finishing all 13 base parachuting jumps).
- **Omega (2 Alien Missions)**:
  - *Far Out* and *The Final Frontier* (requires finding all 50 Spaceship Parts to deliver the Space Docker).
- **Peter Dreyfuss (1 Mystery Resolution)**:
  - *A Starlet in Los Santos*: Unlocked after assembling all 50 Letter Scraps revealing the murderer of Leonora Johnson.

## Troubleshooting & Stalled Missions
- If Dom's final mission (*Uncalculated Risk*) fails to appear near the Land Act Reservoir dam, ensure Franklin has completed every parachute icon on the world map.
- If Tonya stops calling, manually dial Tonya from Franklin's contact list to trigger the dispatch queue.

title: 50 Stunt Jumps Masterclass: Physics, Vehicle Choice & Landing Mechanics
contentMarkdown:
# 50 Stunt Jumps Complete Masterclass

Completing Stunt Jumps in GTA V requires strict adherence to cinematic camera landing physics. For the game to register a jump as "Stunt Jump Completed", your vehicle must take off from the designated ramp, achieve minimum air distance, and land cleanly on all four wheels (or two wheels) within a designated invisible landing box without rolling or striking walls.

## Optimal Vehicle Selection
- **Pegassi Bati 801 Motorcycle**: The undisputed king for 90% of stunt jumps. Its rapid acceleration, compact hitbox, and mid-air pitch/roll control allow surgical precision in tight landing zones.
- **Bravado Buffalo S (Franklin's Custom)**: Fully upgraded engine, brakes, and suspension provide the ideal balance of mass and stability for wide highway ramps where bikes might overshoot.

## Critical Landing Mechanics
- **Four-Wheel Touchdown**: Always keep the vehicle level in mid-air using the left analog stick (pitch nose down slightly before impact).
- **Avoid Over-Speeding**: The most common reason for "Stunt Jump Failed" is overshooting the landing zone entirely. Some jumps require modest half-throttle approaches rather than full nitro-speed launches.
- **Franklin's Special Ability**: Activate Franklin's driving ability on the approach to align your vehicle with millimetric precision on the apex of the ramp, then disengage just before launch to maintain natural physics trajectory.
- **Quick-Save Before Every Attempt**: Park 50 meters back and quick-save on your iFruit phone. If you crash or destroy your ride, instantly reload rather than visiting hospital/impound.

title: Top 10 Hardest Stunt Jumps & How to Nail Every Clean Landing
contentMarkdown:
# Conquering the 10 Hardest Stunt Jumps in GTA V

While many jumps in Los Santos offer generous landing zones, several feature punishingly tight margins, lethal water hazards, or instant multi-star police responses.

## 1. The Bolingbroke Penitentiary Jump (Jump #40)
- **Location**: South cliff overlooking Bolingbroke Penitentiary fence.
- **Hazard**: Overshooting lands inside the high-security prison yard, instantly triggering a 4-star wanted level with hostile guard towers.
- **Strategy**: Approach in a Pegassi Bati 801 at approximately 65% throttle. Your objective is landing directly on the perimeter asphalt strip between the double razor-wire fences.

## 2. El Gordo Lighthouse Rock (Jump #44)
- **Location**: East Blaine County coastline near Ursula's house.
- **Hazard**: A narrow natural rock ramp pointing out to sea towards the lighthouse islet. Missing drops you into deep sea water, drowning your ride.
- **Strategy**: Use an off-road Sanchez or fully tuned sports car. Hit the center spine of the rock ramp at full throttle and pitch down aggressively to plant all tires on the tiny grassy knoll.

## 3. Del Perro Freeway Overpass Drop (Jump #14)
- **Location**: Downtown Los Santos overpass guardrail break.
- **Hazard**: Extremely high vertical drop between highway multi-level ramps with heavy civilian traffic below.
- **Strategy**: Use Franklin. Trigger special ability, hit the concrete divider gap squarely, level the pitch flat mid-air, and release the gas upon impact to prevent fishtailing into traffic.

title: Flight School All 12 Lessons Gold Medal Walkthrough
contentMarkdown:
# Flight School 12 Lessons Gold Medal Guide

The Flight School at Los Santos International Airport (LSIA) maxes out character Flying skill rapidly and is required for 100% completion. Earning gold medals across all 12 lessons requires mastery of rudder controls (yaw) and smooth throttle management.

## The 12 Lessons & Gold Medal Benchmarks
1. **Take Off**: Accelerate down runway, pull back gently at 50 knots, retract landing gear immediately. Target: Under 32 seconds.
2. **Runway Landing**: Line up runway early, drop gear, throttle down to idle, flare nose up 5 degrees before tarmac contact. Target: Under 35 seconds.
3. **Inverted Flight**: Roll 180 degrees into inverted flight, hold steady using opposite rudder and elevator pressure. Target: Under 1 minute 40 seconds.
4. **Knife Flight**: Bank wings 90 degrees vertical and apply top rudder to maintain altitude while passing navigation rings. Target: Under 54 seconds.
5. **Flat Hatting (Low Altitude)**: Fly through low canyon checkpoints without clipping wings or terrain. Target: Under 2 minutes 15 seconds.
6. **Touch and Go**: Touch down on airfield tarmac and immediately throttle up to take off again without coming to a stop. Target: Under 45 seconds.
7. **Top Target (Skydiving)**: Jump from helicopter, deploy parachute at 300 feet, hold both brake toggles to land dead center on target marker. Target: 0 meters error.
8. **Helicopter Course**: Navigate tight checkpoints around city skyscrapers using delicate rudder turns and collective control. Target: Under 2 minutes 10 seconds.
9. **Helicopter Speed Run**: Full forward pitch throughout the coastal course to maintain maximum airspeed. Target: Under 2 minutes 10 seconds.
10. **Skydiving Target Landing**: Precision drop onto a moving flatbed truck trailer. Target: Land cleanly on flatbed.
11. **Earn Your Wings**: High-speed aerobatic course through Los Santos bridges and cranes. Target: Under 2 minutes 50 seconds.

## Key Control Tips
- Always utilize LB/RB (L1/R1) rudder pedals for horizontal course corrections instead of rolling the wings, which bleeds airspeed and destabilizes altitude.

title: 50 Under the Bridge Precision Aircraft Routing & Techniques
contentMarkdown:
# 50 Under the Bridge Precision Aviation Guide

Flying under bridges in GTA V tests your aerodynamic precision. While 25 bridge passes are required for 100% completion, completing all 50 awards the "Close Shave" achievement/trophy.

## Recommended Aircraft
- **Nagasaki Buzzard Attack Chopper**: Compact rotor diameter and exceptional hover stability make the Buzzard the best choice for 45 out of the 50 bridges, particularly narrow canal bridges.
- **Western Company Mallard Stunt Plane**: Essential for bridges that require high speed or have clearance too shallow for vertical helicopter tail rotors.

## High-Hazard Bridges & Strategies
- **Los Santos River Flood Control Canals (Bridges #1 to #8)**:
  - Multiple concrete support pillars run underneath highway viaducts near Olympic Freeway.
  - Keep altitude locked 5 feet above the water surface and use rudder pedals exclusively to thread between columns.
- **Del Perro Freeway Multi-Tier Bridges (Bridges #15 to #19)**:
  - Triple-stacked concrete arches with hanging highway signs.
  - Approach from the west heading east to take advantage of descending grade topography.
- **Miriam Turner Overpass & Port of Los Santos Bridges**:
  - Overhead suspension cables and gantry cranes surround the port.
  - Check for tall cargo vessels moored underneath before initiating your flight corridor.

## Golden Rules for Completion
- Do not allow rotor blades or wingtips to touch any bridge pillar; even minor sparks will invalidate the pass.
- Fly cleanly through both entry and exit thresholds before pulling up.

title: 15 Knife Flights Narrow Gaps Navigation (Mallard & P-996 LAZER)
contentMarkdown:
# 15 Knife Flights Master Navigation Guide

Knife Flights require flying an airplane with its wings tilted 90 degrees vertically between two towering skyscrapers or narrow structural gaps. 8 knife flights are needed for 100% completion; completing all 15 completes the aerial portion of the "Close Shave" award.

## Aircraft Selection & Flight Dynamics
- **Western Company Mallard**: The only recommended aircraft. Its high roll rate and strong rudder authority provide superior lift while knife-flying. Jet fighters like the P-996 LAZER are too wide and carry too much forward inertia for Downtown Los Santos gaps.
- **Aerodynamic Rudder Mechanics**: When banked 90 degrees on your left wing, holding the right rudder pedal (RB/R1) converts yaw into lift, keeping your aircraft level in the air.

## Most Demanding Knife Flight Gaps
- **Downtown Financial District (Schlongberg Sachs & IAA Buildings)**:
  - The tightest corridor in the game. Approach from Vinewood heading south.
  - Enter knife flight 200 meters prior to the gap, level altitude to match the 20th floor, and hold steady rudder pressure through the canyon.
- **Rockford Hills Luxury Hotel Gaps**:
  - Flanked by high glass atriums. Watch for rooftop antenna arrays and air conditioning units on entry.
- **Peaceful Mews Apartments Corridor**:
  - Approach at medium airspeed (60% throttle) to maintain steering authority without suffering aerodynamic flutter.

## Pro Tips
- Quick-save at high altitude over Los Santos prior to every knife flight pass.
- Always center your camera behind the aircraft; cockpit view can obscure wing clearance against glass curtain walls.

title: Free Heavy Weapon Pickups: RPG, Minigun & Combat MG Locations
contentMarkdown:
# Free Heavy Weapon World Pickups Guide

Ammu-Nation charges tens of thousands of dollars for top-tier ordinance and locks them behind story mission gates. However, high-tier heavy weapons spawn at fixed world coordinates from the very beginning of the game for free.

## 1. Minigun Location
- **Fort Zancudo Air Traffic Control Tower**: Located on the top floor of the 6-story ATC tower. Enter Fort Zancudo (use Trevor's invulnerability ability to survive military guards), run into the base tower door, climb the spiral stairs to the top level, and pick up the Minigun resting near the command consoles.

## 2. Rocket Propelled Grenade (RPG)
- **Cypress Flats Industrial Rail Yard**: Inside a hollow decommissioned train car sitting on the eastern spur line.
- **Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness Altruist Radio Tower**: Resting at the base of the broadcast mast within the Altruist Cult perimeter.

## 3. Combat MG & Heavy Sniper
- **Port of Los Santos Cargo Ship Cranes**: Climb the yellow ladders of the oceanic container cranes to find a fully loaded Combat MG perched on the upper observation deck.
- **Paleto Bay Water Tower**: Climb the access ladder of the round municipal water tower behind the bank to retrieve a free Heavy Sniper.

## 4. Sticky Bombs & Grenade Launcher
- **Los Santos River Flood Drainage**: Beneath the bridge arches near the Olympic Freeway junction.
- **Cave Cache near Palmer-Taylor Power Station**: Inside the coastal water cavern south of the power station.

title: Guaranteed Free Supercar Spawns: Truffade Adder & Pegassi Zentorno
contentMarkdown:
# Guaranteed Free Supercar Fixed World Spawns

Purchasing top-tier supercars on Legendary Motorsport costs upwards of $1,000,000. Fortunately, several high-performance hypercars spawn consistently in specific public parking spaces across Los Santos.

## 1. Truffade Adder (Valued at $1,000,000)
- **Location**: Portola Drive in Rockford Hills (Los Santos equivalent of Rodeo Drive).
- **Exact Spawn Point**: Parked curbside right in front of the luxury fashion boutique "Sessanta Nove", directly opposite the Ponsonbys apparel store.
- **Spawn Conditions**: Spawns regularly during daylight hours (09:00 - 17:00). If it does not appear on your first pass, drive around the block twice or switch characters to force a vehicle asset reload.
- **Action**: Drive it directly into Michael's, Franklin's, or Trevor's purchased 4-car safehouse garage to save it permanently.

## 2. Pegassi Zentorno & High-End DLC Fleet
- **Location**: Burton / Downtown Vinewood public multi-story parking garage (near Los Santos Customs).
- **Exact Spawn Point**: Spawns on the ground level or top deck of the parkade near Spanish Avenue.
- **Other Rare Hypercars in the Pool**: Grotti Turismo R, Pegassi Osiris, and Progen T20 can also appear in this exact rotation in single-player updated editions.

## 3. Park Ranger & Vapid Sandking XL
- **Mount Chiliad Cable Car Station**: Park Ranger SUV spawns at the summit station parking lot.
- **Sandy Shores RV Park**: Fully customized lifted Sandking XL spawns near the gas station across from Trevor's trailer.

title: Major World Easter Eggs: Mount Chiliad UFO, Mt Gordo Ghost & Infinity 8
contentMarkdown:
# Major GTA V World Easter Eggs & Mystery Solutions

San Andreas holds some of the gaming industry's most famous and atmospheric mysteries. Here is how to trigger and witness the top four canonical easter eggs in single-player Story Mode.

## 1. The Mount Chiliad UFO
- **Requirements**: Must achieve 100% Story Mode completion first.
- **Activation Conditions**: Reach the wooden viewing platform at the peak of Mount Chiliad at exactly 03:00 AM during a thunderstorm (rain or stormy weather).
- **Observation**: A holographic alien mothership featuring the FIB logo hovers silently above the platform. Shooting at it or approaching via helicopter causes an electromagnetic pulse (EMP) stall.

## 2. The Ghost of Mount Gordo (Jolene Cranley-Evans)
- **Location**: Rocky peak overlooking the El Gordo lighthouse on the north face of Mount Gordo.
- **Time Window**: Spawns every in-game night between 23:00 and 00:00 (midnight).
- **Observation**: The spectral apparition of Jolene Cranley-Evans floats above a boulder with the word "JOCK" written in blood beneath her feet, referencing her murder by gubernatorial candidate Jock Cranley. Approaching too closely causes the ghost to vanish.

## 3. The Infinity 8 Serial Killer Mystery (Merle Abrahams)
- **Clues & Poetry**: 8 rhyming nursery rhyme verses etched onto rocks in Senora Desert and Sandy Shores referencing 8 victims.
- **Victim Location**: Dive north of Paleto Bay to find 8 bodies wrapped in plastic tarps and weighted down at the ocean floor.

## 4. The Thelma & Louise Cliff Jump Tribute
- **Location**: Cliff edge overlooking Raton Canyon in the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness.
- **Time**: Between 19:00 and 20:00 (sunset).
- **Observation**: A convertible Bravado Tornado pursued by two police cruisers speeds off the cliff into the ravine below in an homage to the iconic 1991 film climax.
